claims.text: Climbing styles: sport, multi-pitch, deep-water-soloing, trad.
Sardinia is an island-scale climbing destination with coastal limestone, inland crags and multiple climbing styles.
Climb Europe describes limestone sport climbing around Osilo and Capo Caccia, sea-cliff climbing and DWS, plus broader Sardinian multipitch venues.
The area is better treated as a mixed destination than a single sport crag because the source covers sport, multipitch, DWS and traditional-style venues.
Spring and autumn are assigned as conservative Mediterranean climbing seasons; summer heat is marked as an avoid season pending more granular crag orientation data.
Island access supports flight or ferry access, and a car is recommended for moving between widely separated areas.
